summary: A Yes vote establishes a City of Benicia real property transfer tax on property sales at tiered rates, excluding existing homes selling for less than $2 million and immediate-family transfers.

tax.text: A Yes vote approves allowing the real property transfer tax to take effect if Measure Y also passes, generating revenue for city services.
tax.quote: Measure Z (real property transfer tax): would allow a transfer tax to take effect only if voters approve both Measures Y and Z.

tax.text: A No vote rejects Measure Z, so the real property transfer tax cannot take effect through this measure.
